All Known Implementing Classes:

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface PropertyConverter<T>
A functional interface for converting string values to typed property values.

Converters are used by PropertyDefinition to parse string representations into strongly-typed values.
